lines.text: The cell has a problem. Something sleeps in the drowned cistern. Sapient. We do not know what.
Someone has been scouting it. A Helix recovery team, maybe. We need to know before they do.
I know. That is why I am asking a Spanwright. Light it, or leave it dark. I will not tell you which.
I can scan without waking it. Maybe.
Maybe is how the last one went wrong.
